rules.name: rrr-report-template-check-prod
rules.sql: SELECT business_unit, uuid::text AS uuid, encode(sha256(document_content), 'hex') AS sha256, CASE encode(sha256(document_content), 'hex') WHEN 'ab1cdd67ad3542b3098e8978999c2045543ee2ddf11f1d1826ddd418152957f3' THEN 'NEW' WHEN 'c80d5414ec896ae3571b672a244abaae342856681825b1c68698d69f21a973d1' THEN 'PREVIOUS' WHEN '093acd7303d7463170bf93ce093aa90f8935932390a5ae58d119ed2ebece9531' THEN 'OLD' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS version, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM opera.oga_doctemplatemaster_doctemplatemaster WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND lower(doc_template_name) = 'rrrreport' ORDER BY business_unit
